APPLICATION STATUS UPDATE

Application Evaluation & Feedback

Role: Backend Developer • Vageesha Sharma Talent Acquisition

Dear Arjun Mehta,

Thank you for applying for the Backend Developer position at our organization and for sharing your resume.

Our technical evaluation team has thoroughly reviewed your background against the active role requirements and competencies for this vacancy.

📊 Screening Evaluation Summary Role Match: 48%
Skills Identified in Your Profile:
Node.jsREST APIsSQL / PostgreSQLDatabases
Critical Missing Skills for "Backend Developer":
⚠️ Express⚠️ MongoDB⚠️ Backend Development

🔍 Identified Gaps & Resume Analysis

  • Candidate background is focused in AI Prompt Engineering rather than Backend Developer.
  • Candidate profile lacks production backend server architecture, Node.js/Express, and relational database schema design required for Backend Developer.

💡 Actionable Recommendations to Strengthen Your Profile

  • Apply for roles aligned with AI Prompt Engineering or build dedicated projects in Node.js, Express, REST APIs.
  • Include live project links, portfolio dashboards, and quantifiable metrics in your resume.

At this stage, we are moving forward with candidates whose technical stack more directly matches our immediate requirements for the Backend Developer vacancy.

We will keep your resume on file for future openings that match your specific profile. We wish you great success in your career.

Vageesha Sharma Founder & Hiring Lead Talent Acquisition Division sharmavageesha2000@gmail.com
